name: 4-fluorotryptamine
summary: 4-Fluorotryptamine (4-FT; developmental code name PAL-551) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. It is the 4-fluoro derivative of tryptamine.

pharmacology.text: 4-Fluorotryptamine (4-FT; developmental code name PAL-551) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. The drug acts as a potent full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 28 nM and an Emax of 108%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin–dopamine releasing agent
